description: LAWFUL DEVELOPMENT CERTIFICATE FOR PROPOSED DEMOLITION OF EXISTING CONSERVATORY; ERECTION OF A SINGLE STOREY REAR EXTENSION, REAR DORMER ROOF EXTENSION, AND FRONT PORCH EXTENSION.
decision_conditions: Enlargement of a dwelling house (Class A) - The operations would consist of a single storey rear extension within the meaning of Class A of Part 1 of Schedule 2 to the Town & Country Planning (General Permitted Development)  (England) Order 2015 "the Order" and would comply with the development tolerances set out in said Class A. The operation would therefore have been granted planning permission by Article 3 of the Order.

Enlargement of a dwelling house (Class B) - The operations would consist of the installation of a rear dormer within the meaning of Class B of Part 1 of Schedule 2 to the Town & Country Planning (General Permitted Development)  (England) Order 2015 "the Order" and would comply with the development tolerances set out in said Class B. The operation would therefore have been granted planning permission by Article 3 of the Order.

Enlargement of a dwelling house (Class D) - The operations would consist of the installation of a front porch within the meaning of Class D of Part 1 of Schedule 2 to the Town & Country Planning (General Permitted Development)  (England) Order 2015 "the Order" and would comply with the development tolerances set out in said Class D. The operation would therefore have been granted planning permission by Article 3 of the Order.

Enlargement of a Dwellinghouse (Class G) - The operations would consist of alterations to a chimney within the meaning of Class G of Part 1 of Schedule 2 to “Town & Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 "the Order" and would comply with the development tolerances set out in said Class G. The operation would therefore have been granted planning permission by Article 3 of the Order.
